faq_a1: This app connects people with local home chefs offering single or limited dishes daily. You can browse meals, chat with chefs, and order directly.
faq_q2: Is this a restaurant or delivery service?
faq_a2: No, this app is a marketplace. Home chefs post their meals, and you contact them to reserve, pay, and pick up.
faq_q3: How do I pay for a meal?
faq_a3: You can pay with cash during pickup or use card in the app. Card payments include a small 3% service fee.
faq_q4: Why is card payment more expensive?
faq_a4: The extra cost covers processing fees so the chefs still receive their full price.
faq_a5: Refunds depend on the chef's personal policy. Always contact them in advance if you can’t pick up your meal.
faq_q6: How do I know if a dish is available?
faq_a6: Each dish is limited. After tapping "Confirm Order", the chef will confirm availability via chat.
faq_q7: Can I schedule a pickup time?
faq_a7: Yes, discuss pickup time directly in the chat with the chef.
faq_q8: What if the chef doesn’t respond?
faq_a8: You can cancel and try another dish or report the issue from their profile.
faq_q9: How do I know if a chef is reliable?
faq_a9: Each chef has a profile with ratings, recent meals, dietary tags, and hygiene badges (if verified).
faq_a10: Yes, go to the chef’s profile and tap "Report".
faq_q11: Can I filter meals by my preferences?
faq_a11: Yes, go to Profile → Preferences to set dietary needs and allergy tags.
faq_q12: Will I be warned if a dish has allergens?
faq_a12: Yes. If a chef tags their meals with allergens, you’ll be warned before confirming your order.
faq_a13: Only what’s needed: email, location (for nearby meals), and your selected preferences.
faq_q14: How can I delete my account?
faq_a14: Go to Profile → Personal Data → Delete Account to remove your data permanently.
faq_a15: No. Your card details are processed securely through our payment provider and never stored by us.
faq_a16: Email support@odlua.com or go to Profile → Contact Support.
